tools.name: create_flowchart
tools.description: Turn Mermaid flowchart or graph syntax, or an indented outline, into FlowSimp links. Use it when the steps already exist as text and someone needs a diagram they can view or edit. Returns JSON with shareUrl (a read-only /view# link), editUrl (opens the editor at /?board=), nodeCount, and connectionC

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List every built-in FlowSimp template. Use it when a starter diagram is a better fit than generating one from text. Takes no arguments. Returns JSON with a templates array of id, label, and editUrl. The ids are swimlane, decision-tree, user-flow, org-chart, flowchart, process, network, mind-map, dat

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
